 p2=[(i,j) for i in range(R) for j in range(C) if g[i][j]==2]; p3=[(i,j) for i in range(R) for j in range(C) if g[i][j]==3]
 r2=sum(x for x,y in p2)//len(p2); c2=sum(y for x,y in p2)//len(p2); r3=sum(x for x,y in p3)//len(p3); c3=sum(y for x,y in p3)//len(p3)
 vert= len(set(y for x,y in p2))==1
 if vert:
  # blockers immediately beyond the outward-facing ends
  x=min(i for i,j in p3); y=c3
  while x>0 and g[x-1][y]==0: x-=1
  # horizontal level is row below blocker at 2-side horizontal obstruction
  row=min(r2,r3)
  for j in range(C):
   if g[row][j]==8 and j>c2: break
  # observed convention: row just below obstruction on 2's side
  rr= max(i for i,j in p3)+1
  while rr<R and g[rr][c3]==0: rr+=1
  rr-=1
  for i in range(r3-1, r2+1):
   if 0<=i<R and g[i][c2]==0: a[i][c2]=3
  for j in range(min(c2,c3),max(c2,c3)+1):
   if g[rr][j]==0:a[rr][j]=3
 else:
  # horizontal: extend from right end of 3, and connect upward to left of 2
  y=max(j for i,j in p3)+1
  while y<C and g[r3][y]==0:y+=1
  y-=1
  for j in range(c3+1,y+1):
   if g[r3][j]==0:a[r3][j]=3
  for i in range(min(r2,r3),r3+1):
   if g[i][y]==0:a[i][y]=3
  for j in range(c2-1,y+1):
   if g[r2][j]==0:a[r2][j]=3
 return a"}

{"code":"def transform(g):
    a=[r[:] for r in g]
    p3=[(r,c) for r in range(len(g)) for c in range(len(g[0])) if g[r][c]==3]
    p2=[(r,c) for r in range(len(g)) for c in range(len(g[0])) if g[r][c]==2]
    if not p3 or not p2:return a
    r3=sum(x for x,y in p3)//len(p3); c3=sum(y for x,y in p3)//len(p3)
    r2=sum(x for x,y in p2)//len(p2); c2=sum(y for x,y in p2)//len(p2)
    # horizontal endpoint objects: route from right edge of 3, down, then to 2
    if len(set(x for x,y in p3))==1:
        x=min(y for y in p3); y=max(y for y in p3)
        # first substantial obstacle to right on same row
        obs=[c for c in range(y+1,len(g[0])) if g[r3][c]==8]
        turn=obs[0] if obs else c2
        for c in range(y+1,turn):
            if a[r3][c]==0:a[r3][c]=3
        for r in range(r3+1,r2):
            if a[r][turn]==0:a[r][turn]=3
        for c in range(min(c2,turn),max(c2,turn)+1):
            if a[r2][c]==0:a[r2][c]=3
    return a"}
